PROFIT BEFORE TAX: KShs. 15.1 Billion, up by 54%
(2010: KShs. 9.8 Billions)

Net Interest Income grew by 19% to KShs. 23.3 billion from
KShs. 19.6 billion in 2010 largely attributed to higher asset
growth but offset by high interest costs on wholesale deposits
Fees and commission up by 35% to KShs. 9.2 billion from
KShs. 6.8 billion in 2010 following increase in customer base
and business volume
Foreign exchange income up by 30% to KShs. 3.6 billion from
KShs. 2.8 billion in 2010 mainly due to increased business
volume in foreign currencies
Other operating expenses up by 19% from KShs. 18.7 billion
in 2010 to KShs. 22.3 billion in 2011 as a result of investment
in information technology, consolidation of regional expansion
and a one-off cost of restructuring cost
